articles.summary: TROY, Mich., May 14, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Conifer Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: CNFR) (Conifer or the Company) today announced results for the first quarter ended March 31, 2025. First Quarter 2025 Financial Highlights Personal Lines production was up 22% for the period Net income allocable to common shareholders of $522,000, or $0.04 per share Book value increased to $2.09 per common share outstanding Management Comments Brian Roney, CEO of Conifer, commented
articles.title: Conifer Holdings Reports 2025 First Quarter Financial Results
